title: Ranking Test
parentNote: Encourage him to draw a simple line on paper and place names/letters on it in order as he reads each clue — this "line trick" solves almost every ranking question.
learnBullets: Arranging people/things in order using clues (tallest to shortest, heaviest to lightest, first to last)
Finding someone's **position** in a line (from the front, from the back, or from both!)
The handy trick: **position from front + position from back − 1 = total in the line**
learnItFirst:
**The Big Idea:** You're given clues comparing people two at a time. Line them up in order to answer the question.

```
Reema is taller than Simran.
Simran is taller than Anu.
```
Draw it as a line, tallest on top:
```
Reema   (tallest)
Simran
Anu     (shortest)
```

**Position trick:** If a child is 3rd from the front in a line of 7, their position from the back is:
```
7 − 3 + 1 = 5th from the back
```
*Why the "+1"?* The child gets counted once from the front AND once from the back — subtract 1 so we don't count that same child twice.

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Write down** each clue as an order (who is above/below whom).
2. **Combine** all the clues into ONE single line, top to bottom.
3. **Read off** the answer from your line.

---

questions.content: Reema is taller than Simran. Simran is taller than Anu. Who is the TALLEST?
questions.why: Reema > Simran > Anu, so Reema is the tallest

questions.content: Reema is taller than Simran. Simran is taller than Anu. Who is the SHORTEST?
questions.why: Reema > Simran > Anu, so Anu is the shortest

questions.content: A is older than B. B is older than C. Who is the YOUNGEST?
questions.why: A > B > C in age, so C is the youngest

questions.content: Ravi is heavier than Sam. Sam is heavier than Tom. Who is the HEAVIEST?
questions.why: Ravi > Sam > Tom in weight, so Ravi is the heaviest

questions.content: In a queue of 5 children, Meena is 2nd from the left. How many children are standing IN FRONT of her?
questions.why: If Meena is 2nd, only 1 child is ahead of her

questions.content: In a row of 5 friends, Raj is 3rd from the left. What is his position counted from the right?
questions.why: Position from right = 5 − 3 + 1 = 3rd

questions.content: Tom is standing 1st in a queue of 4 children. How many children are standing BEHIND him?
questions.why: If Tom is 1st out of 4, the other 3 are behind him

questions.content: Five friends A, B, C, D, E stand in a row in that order. Who is in the MIDDLE?
questions.why: In A,B,C,D,E the middle (3rd) position is C

questions.content: Tree A is 5 m tall, Tree B is 8 m tall, Tree C is 3 m tall. Which tree is the TALLEST?
questions.why: 8 m is the biggest of 5 m, 8 m, and 3 m

questions.content: Using Q9's trees, which tree is the SHORTEST?
questions.why: 3 m is the smallest of 5 m, 8 m, and 3 m

questions.content: Aman is taller than Bimal. Bimal is taller than Chetan. Chetan is taller than Deepak. Who is the TALLEST?
questions.why: Aman > Bimal > Chetan > Deepak, so Aman is tallest

questions.content: Using Q11's clues, who is the SHORTEST?
questions.why: Aman > Bimal > Chetan > Deepak, so Deepak is shortest

questions.content: Riya is shorter than Meera but taller than Sonal. Who is the TALLEST of the three?
questions.why: Meera > Riya > Sonal, so Meera is tallest

questions.content: Using Q13's clues, who is the SHORTEST of the three?
questions.why: Meera > Riya > Sonal, so Sonal is shortest

questions.content: In a race, Raj finished before Sam. Sam finished before Tina. Tina finished before Mona. Who WON the race?
questions.why: Raj finished before all the others, so he won

questions.content: Using Q15's clues, who finished LAST?
questions.why: Mona finished after all the others, so she was last

questions.content: In a line of 6 children, Priya is 4th from the left. How many children are standing BEHIND her (to her right)?
questions.why: 6 children total − 4th position = 2 children behind her

questions.content: Using Q17, what is Priya's position counted from the RIGHT?
questions.why: Position from right = 6 − 4 + 1 = 3rd

questions.content: A is heavier than B, but A is lighter than C. Arrange from LIGHTEST to HEAVIEST.
questions.why: B < A < C, so lightest to heaviest is B, A, C

questions.content: Heights: Aman = 120 cm, Bimal = 115 cm, Chetan = 130 cm, Deepak = 110 cm. Who is the TALLEST?
questions.why: 130 cm is the biggest number, so Chetan is tallest

questions.content: Using Q20's heights, who is the SHORTEST?
questions.why: 110 cm is the smallest number, so Deepak is shortest

questions.content: Using Q20's heights, which order is correct from SHORTEST to TALLEST?
questions.why: Ordering the heights 110 < 115 < 120 < 130

questions.content: In a queue, Vikram is 5th from the front and 3rd from the back. How many children are in the queue in TOTAL?
questions.why: Total = 5 (from front) + 3 (from back) − 1 = 7

questions.content: In a row of 7 kids, Meena is 3rd from the left. What is her position from the RIGHT?
questions.why: Position from right = 7 − 3 + 1 = 5th

questions.content: Rohan is older than Mohan. Mohan is older than Sohan. Sohan is older than Rahul. Who is the YOUNGEST?
questions.why: Rohan > Mohan > Sohan > Rahul, so Rahul is the youngest

questions.content: Meena is taller than Sita but shorter than Gita. Gita is shorter than Rita. Who is the TALLEST of all four?
questions.why: Order is Rita > Gita > Meena > Sita, so Rita is tallest

questions.content: Using Q26's clues, who is the SHORTEST of all four?
questions.why: Order is Rita > Gita > Meena > Sita, so Sita is shortest

questions.content: Ravi is 5th in a queue of 9 children, counting from the front. What is his position counted from the BACK?
questions.why: Total children = 9. Position from back = 9 − 5 + 1 = 5th

questions.content: In a line, Neha is 2nd from the left and 6th from the right. How many people are in the line IN TOTAL?
questions.why: Total = 2 (from left) + 6 (from right) − 1 = 7

questions.content: Box P is heavier than Box Q. Box R is heavier than Box P. Box Q is heavier than Box S. Which box is the HEAVIEST?
questions.why: R > P > Q > S, so R (Box R) is the heaviest
